    "Steep learning curve and initial complexity due to the vast number of features and customization options.",
    "Mobile app performance can be inconsistent, especially in areas with poor connectivity.",

  "overall_experience": "This owner likely found ClickUp to be a powerful and highly customizable tool for managing their small business operations. They appreciated its robust features for separating projects, tracking time, and organizing daily work, especially the automations and AI capabilities that saved significant time.
